title: **Exclusive report from General Hassan-Zadeh for the self-sacrificing volunteers of the capital:**
text:
**Exclusive report from General Hassan-Zadeh for the self-sacrificing volunteers of the capital:**"

"**Iran’s first “Janfada” Brigade has been organized and will be sent to operational areas in the near future**"

"At the opening ceremony of the fourth “Janfada” training center in Tajrish Square, Tehran, the commander of the IRGC Tehran Corps said:"

"- Iran’s first Janfada Brigade has been formed. The brigade has completed advanced training and has also been equipped."

"- In the near future, convoys of Janfada volunteer fighters will begin deploying to operational areas in southern and western Iran.
